voltage.basis: linear SVPWM phase-voltage peak m·V_dc/sqrt3 (the passport's rule); the loss grid's operating angles hold at V_dc 22.2 V

psi_map.basis: passport hot psi-map (2-D, virgin magnets at 53.5 C, 71 FEM points), sampled on a regular (I, gamma) table; amplitude-invariant peak dq, gamma from the q-axis

thermal_calibration.basis: fitted 2026-10-12 to 7 coupled EM-thermal FEM anchors (propeller as load and cooling, air_speed_source propeller, slipstream factor 0.4 (behind_hub) for the 3 Stage B anchors, 0.40 / 0.55 with the bench thrust for the 4 bench-point anchors, the machine's own frame and Simulation settings, 25 C air): the lumped network fed each anchor's own losses, least squares on the winding hot spot, hottest magnet and stator mean (weights {'winding': 1.0, 'magnet': 1.0, 'housing': 0.5})
thermal_calibration.slipstream_factor_basis: fitted 2026-10-12 to two MOTRES bench runs of this configuration (open frame, propeller HQ1050-3 = motres_bench_hq1050_3): the 30-min continuous run of 2026-06-23 (770 W shaft, 3455 g, 23.7 V / 43.85 A bus, 150 C 'stabilised', sensor not stated) and the 1 kW continuous run of 2026-08-13 (1014 W shaft, 4300 g, 14400 rpm, 24.6 V / 55 A bus, FOURnamics nCTRL FOC, 201 C IR maximum on the coil). The S1 fixed point driven with the bench shaft power at the bench rpm (06-23: 13196 rpm from the propeller's 06-16 curve) and the wake of the bench thrust, the passport's own losses, 30 C air (not logged; 06-16 was 31.3 C), the measured temperature taken as the winding hot spot, on the network refitted to 7 FEM anchors (incl. 4 at these two bench points); least squares over both points: residuals -3.6 / +1.8 K. Uncertainty +-0.04 (air 25-35 C, shaft power +-3 %, sensor 10 K below the hot spot); the coupled FEM alone reproduces the bench at about 0.51; if the motor losses were 20 % higher than the passport's, 0.73.

bench.loss_check: bench electrical input minus shaft power (motor + ESC) is 269 / 339 W against the passport's motor loss of 64 / 100 W at these points: with a 4 %% ESC loss ~165 / 185 W are not explained by the model. If that heat were in the motor no slipstream factor <= 1.5 reproduces the temperatures (fit case 'extra 100 W'), so the factor assumes the passport losses are right; the FOURnamics sweep of 2026-08-12 (same ESC, cold) agrees with them (977 W shaft, 143 W total).
